4399-4770-4924-8319.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Heartless Summoning.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Greenhouse Propagator trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greenhouse Propagator trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-4924-8319.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

147-7281-8095.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-7281-8095.description:
Cast Leonardo's Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Leonardo's Technique.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Leonardo's Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Leonardo's Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

826-1636-6243-6495.easyPrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-1636-6243-6495.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing another nontoken creature you control to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield as a white Angel.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
826-1636-6243-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6199-6972.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Marionette Apprentice.
When Marionette Apprentice dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Apprentice enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4089-5399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4089-5399.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Glasspool Mimic and Pirated Copy each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4089-5399.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature that has haste

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

3259-4766-5222-7708--166.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4766-5222-7708--166.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Halvar triggers, attaching Breath of Fury to the creature with haste.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to Ares, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Ares and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Ares trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-803-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Arcane Adaptation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-803-2034.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

1563-2457-3129-4478.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

206-2366-4178-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a Forest that does not have summoning sickness and that enters the battlefield untapped.
206-2366-4178-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.

240-2438-4460-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-4585-6972.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three total creatures on the battlefield.
4050-4585-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Custodi Soulbinders.
When Custodi Soulbinders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

851-4508-5880-7223.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

997-3817-4605-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {6}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Sister Hospitaller and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

465-5256-5987.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Angel of Indemnity from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

4017-5641-7173.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-5641-7173.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-4694-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
1978-4694-7013.description:
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat

573-654-5702-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
573-654-5702-6850.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters, Amulet of Vigor, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Gruul Turf.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

141-554-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-554-5231.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

328-2173-5220-6798.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-2173-5220-6798.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

338-2498-2541.description:
Activate Benthic Biomancer by paying {1}{U}, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, causing you to loot.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain at least 2 life.
Benthic Biomancer triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-3480-3967.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1477-2558-6291-6757.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers.
Holding priority, activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Thopter.
Repeat from step 2.
1477-2558-6291-6757.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions tokens to Extruder to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

567-678-5670.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana with the mana to cast it.
567-678-5670.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1651-2034-2797-6441.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Servos, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
1651-2034-2797-6441.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Retrofitter Foundry's first ability to untap it and get infinite untapped Servo tokens.

190-389-739-5248.notablePrerequisites: You have Gideon of the Trials' emblem. Gideon of the Trials is on the battlefield, or you control a Gideon planeswalker.
190-389-739-5248.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Nine Lives and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, however you cannot lose the game due to Gideon of the Trials.
Cast Cleansing Nova by paying its mana cost, destroying all enchantments.
When each opponent's Nine Lives leaves the battlefield, they each trigger, causing each opponent to lose the game.

586-5256-5626-6112.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Fumulus's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Priest of Gix's power.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Insect and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it
as a copy of Rite of Passage

292-3693-4948.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage and Estrid's Invocation trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.

1116-3240-4289-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token creature with haste.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill a card.
Activate the Graveborn token using the ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Graveborn token.
Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Activate Nether Traitor using the ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1335-2034-2216.notablePrerequisites: At least three +1/+1 counters on Marath.
1335-2034-2216.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, choosing to create a creature token.
Unbound Flourishing's last ability triggers, copying Marath's ability.
Resolve both Marath abilities, creating two 1/1 Elemental tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Elemental token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, choosing to place counters.
Unbound Flourishing's last ability triggers, copying Marath's ability.
Resolve both Marath abilities, putting two +1/+1 counters on Marath.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite creature tokens, you may activate Ashnod's Altar any number of times for infinite mana.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Marath any number of times, placing any number of +1/+1 counters on it due to Unbound Flourishing, and then on any number of other creatures as well.
Once there are infinite +1/+1 counters on Marath, you may activate it any number of times to deal infinite damage to any targets.

2034-3249-3652.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, targeting Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from graveyard by paying {0}.
Repeat.
